target_customer: Accounting and finance teams at construction and manufacturing companies using NetSuite, Sage Intacct or QuickBooks
problem: Accounts payable, receivable, reconciliation and vendor management are manual in construction and manufacturing, with cost codes, PO tolerances and lien waivers. ProcIndex runs agents inside the customer's ERP under approval rules.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI accounting agents; pricing not public

founders.name: Neha Suresh
education: Carnegie Mellon University (alum, degree not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: led engineering at Zoho and was on the founding engineering team of Zoho Books India.

competitors.name: Yooz
competitors.what: AI accounts payable automation with a deeper Sage Intacct Construction integration

competitors.name: CrewCost
competitors.what: AI-powered accounts payable module for general contractors

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable agents that post transactions to multiple ERPs with approval controls; integration depth and accuracy are the hard parts, and the site claims a 98.1 percent no-touch rate.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and approval workflows embed deeply in finance operations, but several AP vendors target construction.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established AP vendors and ERP vendors added AI features during 2025; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Construction and manufacturing finance teams handle high invoice volumes, and vendors such as Yooz and Ottimate market AP automation to them, indicating spend. The founders' Zoho Books experience supports domain insight.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, practical, direct, second person to finance teams

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch listed for February 2026; no other community found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found and the name has no stated meaning.

outcome_analysis: ProcIndex is active with a small team and customer metrics claimed on its site for January to October 2026. Founders have accounting software and engineering backgrounds. No funding amount is public, and the field has many funded AP vendors, so its trajectory is unproven.
notes: Standout lists the last stage as Seed with the founders as listed investors; no amount or outside investor, so no round recorded. Team size shows 4 on YC and 2 in a snippet. Site is copyrighted to Cosmoverse, Inc.
